package.description: Leakage control system based on Regulation (EC) No 842/2006.

en-US.description: Leakage control system based on Regulation (EC) No 842/2006.
en-US.longDescription: Leaklog is a leakage control system based on Regulation (EC) No 2024/573. It logs findings and parameters of leakage checks, shows a history of the development of parameters, compares them with nominal ones and calculates the percentage of leakage.
en-US.name: Leaklog

zh-CN.description: 基于欧盟法规 (EC) No 842/2006 的泄漏控制系统。
zh-CN.longDescription: Leaklog 是一款基于欧盟法规 (EC) No 2024/573 的泄漏控制系统。该系统可记录泄漏检查的结果和参数，显示参数变化历史，将其与标准值进行对比，并计算泄漏百分比。
